_about: Drift-test B (unconditional): the frozen raw-value contract for the :insights domain enums. Generated ONCE from the Kotlin enums (which mirror the Swift EndoInsights sources verbatim). Lists are in declaration order; EnumRawValueParityTests asserts the live enums equal this file every run. Keys beginning with '_' are notes and are ignored by the assertion.
_note_FactorKind_phase18: FactorKind is app-side (Phase 18 persistence discriminator) and is deliberately NOT ported into :insights — the engine uses the Factor sealed interface. Its 7 raw values are recorded here so a future Phase-18 app-side drift test can adopt them: [food, activity, sleep, medication, stress, mood, other].
